title: a tester red whose checkout has no commons to ticket it in raises a trouble naming the proof, never only a stderr line
intention: When a tester run measures a red it cannot ticket because the derived ticket store is in no git tree, the red is made permanent in a trouble naming the proof and the store, so it is not lost when the run's stderr scrolls away.
why: Measured 2026-11-20 on akiendelllinux: the reseal inside commit 5ce287992, run from worktree /var/tmp/wt-07d7 whose sibling has no CairnCommons, sealed bin/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code_from_the_launcher.py red; red_tickets._commons_top derived the store /var/tmp/CairnCommons/tickets and raised StoreUnreachable ('in no git tree'); cairn/devices/tester/device.py (except StoreUnreachable, near line 996) printed 'was NOT ticketed' to stderr and emitted a red_unticketed breadcrumb, and the run went on. No ticket and no trouble exist for that red: it was found again only by hand. Law 7: a red is a record of truth; a stderr line is not.
traces_to: Law 7 (errors are permanent in records of truth) and 207c4074b3d5 (reds don't get lost, outline 9.4.2.3.7.5)
how: In cairn/devices/tester/device.py, the except StoreUnreachable branch keeps its print and emit and adds self.raise_trouble('tester-red-unticketed:' + <proof path relative to the repo, else as given>, why=<names the proof, the store and the reason>, detail={'proof', 'store_reason'}). A raise that itself fails prints and does not kill the run. When a later run of the same proof tickets its red (ticket_what_is_new returns) or the proof runs green, the trouble clears if it stands (read through cairn.devices.trouble.tools.store.store.live, as reseal.run_or_record does). The house commons is never written (58e242c8be4f's wrong_intent). The red-first proof copies cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_red_casts_only_into_its_own_commons.py's harness: a scratch git checkout under a scratch HOME with no CairnCommons beside it, red_tickets.ROOTS pointed at it, and TesterDevice().run_proof on a red fixture inside it (sink='none', isolation='none'), marked testing.

clauses.claim: a red measured in a scratch checkout whose sibling has no CairnCommons raises trouble 'tester-red-unticketed:<proof>' whose why names the proof and the unreachable store, and the run still returns its red record
in that run no file is written under any CairnCommons, the house commons included, and the stderr line 'was NOT ticketed' still prints
the same proof run green afterwards clears that trouble, and a green with no standing trouble writes no clear

decisions.text: D1: the unticketable red raises a per-proof trouble through the tester's own raiser (DiagnosticBase.raise_trouble); it never falls back to the house commons, which 58e242c8be4f ruled out for a worktree's reds.
D2: the trouble clears on the proof's next green or next successful ticketing, only when it stands, read through the trouble store's published live() as reseal.run_or_record does.
D3: the red-first proof copies test_a_red_casts_only_into_its_own_commons.py's scratch-checkout harness, one tooth per clause.
